claim_audit_results.claim_summary: FIELDWISE central aim/research question: convert physiological water-stress signatures from multi-year processing-tomato data into a parsimonious framework reliable under unseen-year and prospective validation, made crop-configurable.

O2 measurable target (ranked predictors; primary model+benchmark; calibration/uncertainty; model card; crop-transfer spec).
